notablePrerequisites:
Deadeye Navigator is paired with Agent Frank Horrigan.
Crystalline Crawler has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
description:
Activate Agent Frank Horrigan by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Agent Frank Horrigan enters the battlefield, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger.
Resolve the Agent Frank Horrigan trigger, causing you to put two +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Agent Frank Horrigan.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.
